subject: Follow-up on your large upload failures (MetaDefender ICAP Server)
body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for your time on the call today.

Issue: uploads over about 50 MB fail after roughly a minute.

What we found:
- ICAP Server stops waiting for Core after 60 seconds, then returns the 500 error to your portal.
- The failing files are mostly large zip archives, up to about 80 MB.

Next steps:
1. You: send the full ICAP Server log for one failed upload and the size of your largest zip, this afternoon.
2. Me: confirm the exact timeout and archive settings and send you the steps.
3. Me: tell you what to test once you have applied them.

Please keep the timeout unchanged until you have my steps, so we only change one thing at a time.

Background on the timeout setting: https://docs.example-opswat.invalid/icap/configuration/scan-timeouts

claims_needing_verification.claim: The 60-second ICAP timeout is the sole cause of the failures.
claims_needing_verification.reason: Core archive limits may also play a part; not yet confirmed.
